currency.justification: The cash payments are denoted by '$' and the acquiring company, Puma Exploration Inc., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), a Canadian exchange, implying Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is $270,000, calculated by summing the payments outlined in the agreement: a $10,000 signing payment, a $10,000 payment at the end of due diligence, a $20,000 payment by July 2024, a $25,000 payment by July 2025, a $30,000 payment by July 2026, and additional performance payments of $25,000 (PEA), $50,000 (FS), and $100,000 (commercial production).

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the deal are listed separately and no combined total value is provided in the text.

Issue 200,000 common shares... Issue 200,000 common shares... Issue 250,000 common shares... Issue 350,000 common shares..."

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.075'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement includes a commitment to "Conduct $80,000 of exploration work on the property between July 1 and December 30, 2023".

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction terms state that "The seller will retain a 2% NSR (net smelter return) royalty on any commercial production from the property." Puma has an option to purchase half of this royalty.
